explanation.en: IF runs its block when the comparison is true. ELSE runs the alternative when the earlier tests are false; only one branch runs.
explanation.ar: تنفّذ IF مجموعتها إذا صحت المقارنة. تنفّذ ELSE البديل إذا لم تصح الاختبارات السابقة؛ ويُنفّذ فرع واحد فقط.

explanation.en: ELSEIF tests another condition only after earlier tests fail. Put the highest score threshold first so 80 is High rather than Medium.
explanation.ar: تختبر ELSEIF شرطاً آخر بعد فشل الاختبارات السابقة فقط. ضع حد الدرجة الأعلى أولاً كي تكون 80 ضمن High لا Medium.

misconception.en: Every true ELSEIF branch runs, even after an earlier branch was selected.
misconception.ar: تُنفّذ كل فروع ELSEIF الصحيحة حتى بعد اختيار فرع سابق.

learningObjectives.en: Classify ranges with ELSEIF

explanation.en: > excludes equality; >= includes it. Test values below, at and above a threshold to check the business rule.

misconception.en: The comparisons > 5000 and >= 5000 agree for exactly 5000.
misconception.ar: تعطي المقارنتان > 5000 و>= 5000 النتيجة نفسها للقيمة 5000 تماماً.

learningObjectives.en: Test threshold boundaries

explanation.en: DO n TIMES enters the block n times. ENDDO returns to the loop until those passes are complete.

learningObjectives.en: Repeat a block a known number of times

explanation.en: A counter increases each pass. An accumulator adds the current counter to the previous total; WRITE after ENDDO displays one final total.
explanation.ar: يزداد العداد في كل دورة. يضيف متغير التجميع العداد الحالي إلى المجموع السابق؛ وتعرض WRITE بعد ENDDO المجموع النهائي مرة واحدة.

misconception.en: Resetting the total to zero inside every pass preserves the running sum.

explanation.en: During DO and WHILE, sy-index reports the current pass starting at 1. It is maintained by the runtime; a separate counter such as lv_count changes only when your code updates it.

misconception.en: A user-defined lv_count automatically increases whenever sy-index increases.
misconception.ar: يزداد lv_count المعرّف من المستخدم تلقائياً كلما زادت sy-index.

learningObjectives.en: Distinguish persistence, CDS, behavior, projection, service definition and binding.
